observations: Title-masked blind inspection of the interactive capsule and visual plates unmistakably identifies Calvino's Cities & Memory 2 from its 6 concrete stones: the long wild-region ride desiring a city, seashell-encrusted golden spiral staircases, 3:2 fifth-tuned violins and vernier brass telescopes, the foreigner hesitating between two women always encountering a third, cockfights erupting into bloody bettors' brawls, and the limestone parapet wall where seated elders watch youth pass.

Every desire pursued across all 5 spiral chambers strictly and irreversibly advances ageProgress (zero rewind), smoothly receding the nautilus sanctum across the dusk piazza while raising the foreground stone wall and seating the visitor among the row of elders where desires dispatch passing youths and chisel memory tablets ('Desires are already memories').
